recipe.build:
sed -r '/(play|github)SigningConfig/d' -i app/build.gradle.kts
PROF_FILE=app/build/intermediates/binary_art_profile/githubRelease/compileGithubReleaseArtProfile/baseline.prof
PROF_SHA1=56e1a77857c660767429a4b66a016d27b961f19f
for _ in {1..10}; do
./gradlew clean :app:assembleGithubRelease -Pvoice.includeProprietaryLibraries=false -Dorg.gradle.jvmargs=-Xmx2048m -D"-XX:MaxMetaspaceSize=1024m" --no-build-cache --no-configuration-cache --no-daemon
find . -name 'baseline.prof'
test -f "$PROF_FILE"
if [ "$( sha1sum "$PROF_FILE" | cut -d' ' -f1 )" = "$PROF_SHA1" ]; then
break
fi
done
echo ./gradlew :app:assembleGithubRelease -Pvoice.includeProprietaryLibraries=false -Dorg.gradle.jvmargs=-Xmx2048m -D"-XX:MaxMetaspaceSize=1024m"
find . -name '*.apk'
mv app/build/outputs/apk/github/release/app-github-release-unsigned.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk
